newsitem.title: UK: ORANGE UP AHEAD OF H1 RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: ORANGE UP AHEAD OF H1 RESULTS.

text.p: Shares in UK mobile phone group Orange Plc climbed to a two-month high in active trading on Tuesday ahead of the company's interim results, due on Thursday, dealers said.
At 1249 GMT, the shares were up 6p to 215 on volume of more than seven million. They were among the most actively traded in London.
Dealers also reported a buyer of 1,000 September 220 calls at 7p to 8-1/2p in the options market.
"It's just speculation ahead of the figures," said one dealer. "People are betting they'll be good."
Five analysts surveyed by Reuters were expecting Orange's losses to narrow to 83.6 million stg in the most recent period from 125.2 million stg a year ago.
